description.value: The Dayton Audio SS8-PR 8" Signature Series Passive Radiator is the perfect low-frequency companion to the SS8-22 subwoofer, offering deep bass extension from compact enclosures without the need for long, noisy ports. Designed to match the Signature Series in both looks and performance, the SS8-PR features the same rigid cast aluminum frame, anodized aluminum cone, and rubber surround as its powered counterpart. With Dayton Audio's innovative Sandwich Mass Structure (SMS) system, fine-tuning your enclosure is simple and precise, making the SS8-PR an excellent choice for high-performance home audio, home theater, and car audio systems.Product HighlightsSignature Series styling with cast aluminum frame, aluminum cone, and rubber surround - visually identical to the SS8-22 driverPassive radiator design eliminates port noise and allows deep bass in compact enclosuresSandwich Mass Structure (SMS) keeps added mass between spider and surround for stability and symmetryEasy tuning via threaded bolt, wing nut, and nylock nut assemblyIncludes five 46 g weights for customizable mass loading and flexible tuning optionsPerfect companion for the Dayton Audio SS8-22 subwoofer in compact systemsProduct Manuals / Spec Sheets / DownloadsDayton Audio SS8-PR Specification SheetBuying OptionsBuy on Parts ExpressBuy Internationally
